description: This file defines the 'Template' entity class within the Fineract project. It models a template object with properties such as name, entity type, template type, text content, and associated mappers. It also includes methods for constructing instances from JSON commands, managing mappers, and accessing properties.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Represents a template entity for email, SMS, or document generation within the Fineract system. Contains properties such as name, entity type, template type, content text, and associated mappers, with functionality to instantiate from JSON commands, retrieve mappers as a map, and manage properties.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a Template instance from a JsonCommand object by extracting parameters and building the mappers list.

methods.name: getMappersAsMap
methods.description: Returns the mappers as a LinkedHashMap of key-value pairs.

methods.name: getMappers
methods.description: Returns the list of TemplateMapper objects.

methods.name: setMappers
methods.description: Sets the list of TemplateMapper objects.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the template.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity type of the template.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity type of the template.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the textual content of the template.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the textual content of the template.
